task_list: Update validCode() so it accepts the actual dot-separated recovery-code format, for example by allowing . in the preliminary character validation or by replacing the preliminary validation with the existing structured id.secret validation.

Verify that a generated mockCode can be:
  submitted manually in the verification form, and
  used through the #verify?code=... mock recovery link.
Run an end-to-end recovery test after the validation fix: recover → verify → reset password → MFA → sign in → accept privacy conditions.
Add an expiresAt field to Session, set it when creating a session, and reject/delete expired sessions before serving the page or processing any API action.
Add periodic or opportunistic cleanup of expired entries from both sessions and resets.
Replace the global passwordHash variable with account-scoped password state, such as a server-side account record keyed by a non-exposed internal account identifier.
Bind each reset record and authenticated session to the same internal account identifier, and ensure sign-in verifies only that account’s stored password hash.
Ensure a reset in one account/recovery context cannot alter sign-in behavior or password verification for any other session/account context.
